name: ANRF National Post-Doctoral Fellowship (N-PDF)
funder: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Government of India
amount: Rs 80,000/month + HRA (Rs 50,000/month + HRA until PhD is awarded) + Rs 2 lakh/year research grant + Rs 1 lakh/year overhead
other_rules: upper age limit 35 at submission (5-year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD and women)
must apply within 5 years of PhD viva-voce
cannot work with PhD guide/co-guide or at the PhD department/institution
mentor must hold a regular position in India
not open to anyone who has previously applied for regular ANRF grants (PMECRG, ARG, IRG etc.)
notes: 2026 call ran 15 Jan to 20 Feb 2026 (ANRF schedule listed 17 Feb, ISTI listed 20 Feb); the 2027 call is expected around the same time. Must join within 3 months of results; no change of mentor or institution after results. Research grant covers minor equipment, consumables, contingencies and domestic travel; no manpower.

documents.name: Work methodology and research plan
documents.notes: Single PDF, max 10 MB; title, summary, objectives and outcomes entered online
